description.value: A resort-style campground sitting directly on Heffley Lake between Kamloops and Sun Peaks, with showers, fire pits, water-activity rentals, and an on-site bistro; the amenities and lake access make it a genuine layover destination, though the seasonal window (mid-May to end of September) and resort pricing apply.

address.value: 2544 Golden Horn Road, Heffley Creek, BC V0E 1Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fully loaded and confirms the OSM address (2544 Golden Horn Road, Heffley Creek, BC V0E 1Z0) and phone (1.250.214.7400). The amenities page explicitly lists shower facilities, a store, fire pits, picnic tables, and an on-site licensed bistro, while OSM tags (shower=yes, camp_site=serviced, tents=yes, reservation=required) are all corroborated. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, device charging, pump, tools, or camping fuel anywhere on the site.
concerns: Minor name discrepancy: website title reads 'Lakeside Heffley Hideaways' (plural) while OSM and the rest of the website body use 'Lakeside Heffley Hideaway' (singular).
Seasonal operation only: Open May 15 – Sept 30 per website footer.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active seasonal campsite with tent sites, serviced sites, on-site food, and showers on a scenic lake between Kamloops and Sun Peaks — a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on that corridor.

wow_evidence: shower facilities, a store, fire pits, picnic tables, and an on-site licensed bistro
